title: Hay Farming Basics and Plant Options Explained I

tasks.task_text: Describe the variety of hay crops and their usage.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the variety of hay crops and their usage.
subtasks.text: Mention the variety of hay crops like Ryegrass, Timothy, Brome, Fescue, Bermuda grass, Orchard grass, Clovers, and Alfalfa.

tasks.task_text: Explain the process of hay preparation from cutting to storing.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the process of hay preparation from cutting to storing.
subtasks.text: Describe how hay is prepared by cutting fresh plant material and baling it when at its most nutritional value.

tasks.task_text: Highlight the evolution of hay baling equipment.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight the evolution of hay baling equipment.
subtasks.text: Note how hay baling equipment evolved from stationary machines to mobile machinery in the early 20th century.

tasks.task_text: Discuss the methods of storing hay and their importance.

subtasks.task_text: Discuss the methods of storing hay and their importance.
subtasks.text: Explain that hay should be kept dry to preserve its nutritional value and that storage methods have evolved over time.
